summary: Validated the rebalanced tiered Projects grid in Projects.jsx across desktop (1366), tablet (768), and mobile (390). Layout, modals, badge, and regression sections all behave as specified.

fanuc.note: full-width horizontal, no Flagship badge, image left / text right

fiu_vex.note: same y as eco, half-width, no gap

test_results.tablet_768: Cobot and FANUC render full-width (688w). Eco/VEX stay side-by-side at 334w each — graceful.
test_results.mobile_390: All four cards stack vertically at 342w, no horizontal overflow (viewport 390).
test_results.modals: All 4 project cards (cobot, fanuc, eco, vex) open their case-study modal and close with ESC.
test_results.regression: Hero 3D canvas present, nav shows HOME/PROJECTS/TIMELINE/ABOUT ME, Resume floating module visible on all breakpoints.

critical_code_review_comments: Projects.jsx has duplicated card body markup for 'featured' vs 'large' branches (~30 lines of near-identical JSX). Minor DRY improvement opportunity — could extract a shared HorizontalCardBody component — but not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Projects grid now has tiered layout: row1 = Cobot featured full-width (Flagship badge), row2 = FANUC 'large' horizontal full-width (no badge), row3 = Eco + VEX half-width medium cards. SPAN map in Projects.jsx: featured/large=md:col-span-6, medium=md:col-span-3. data-testids unchanged.
